title: Zucchini Zest Monsoon Zweet
description: A diabetic-friendly umami and chewy Canadian dish featuring zucchini, seasoned with a touch of umami and savory flavors to resemble a monsoon flavor profile.
instructions: Trim the ends of the zucchini and slice them into rounds.
In a large pan, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add minced garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add sliced zucchini to the pan. Season with kosher salt and cook for about 5 minutes or until they start to soften slightly.
Drizzle on diabetes-friendly tamari sauce (if using), stir well, then continue cooking for an additional 2-3 minutes to allow flavors to meld together.
Once fully cooked, remove from heat and serve immediately.
